datasets.about: Workers and the things they wear and use, built by scripts/make-helpers.py (self-authored pictures). Jobs step 1 is "who helps us?"; each step after it is one worker: the lesson names the worker and each thing, then the quiz. Pre-K meets the workers; Kindergarten learns the names of their things; 1st grade also learns what each thing is for.
